scope: D256 Volta SWA, 16K keys, 256 queries, 16 Q heads, 8 KV heads, bounded 1280 visible keys
findings: Full QKV keeps P/dS in shared memory, recomputes dP twice, and atomically accumulates dK/dV. It is slower than partial fusion.
Q-only variants hold P in registers and dS in shared memory with no global P/dS matrices. Best measured time still exceeds existing Q-only path.
Two dQ accumulator tiles reuse dS loads and improve Q-only speed from about 1.49 to 1.39 ms.
Staging Q/dO in shared memory regresses performance; no deployment.
